items.q: Is converting Word to PDF free?
items.a: Yes, converting Word to PDF is free within the daily usage limits shown above.
Most fonts, images, and layout carry over well, but complex documents may shift slightly during conversion — this is a known characteristic of automated document conversion, not unique to this tool.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
